body: The United States is upgrading airports and airfields across the Second Island Chain as part of the US Air Force's Agile Combat Employment (ACE) doctrine, dispersing aircraft from Guam to reduce reliance on Andersen Air Force Base. One of the most significant programs is the transformation of Yap International Airport in the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM). The Air Force's Fiscal Year 2025 Military Construction budget request included around $400 million for a runway extension and related work, with the first increment funded at $96 million, though program execution has slipped from FY2025 to FY2026.

Yap International Airport today is a simple single-runway airport with a basic terminal. The only scheduled passenger flights are United Airlines Boeing 737 MAX 8 services from Guam twice weekly, and Pacific Missionary Aviation (PMA) flights once a week from Palau using its two Super King Airs. Adjacent to the airport lies an abandoned Japanese WWII airfield littered with aircraft destroyed by American bombing; the author found around eight Japanese airplanes there. When he visited in October and November, work on the airport had not yet started and the US military footprint on the island was minimal.

The strategic driver is China. Following WWII, the United States consolidated its airpower on Guam while maintaining forward bases in Japan and Korea. The rise of China puts those bases — and Guam itself, now a prime target — at risk; without Guam or an effective alternative, the US ability to project airpower over the region would diminish drastically. The funding justification for Yap emphasizes the need for a longer runway and facilities to support larger military aircraft for training, operations, contingency and Agile Combat Employment.

The effort spans the Second Island Chain: Peleliu Airfield in Palau is undergoing major construction, Angaur Airfield is already complete, and on Guam the USAF is expanding parking areas at Andersen Air Force Base and rehabilitating the formerly abandoned Northwest Field. On Tinian, the USAF is expanding and rehabilitating Tinian International Airport and the formerly abandoned North Field, while nearby Rota, home to fewer than 2,000 inhabitants, has also drawn interest. In Australia, effort focuses on northern RAAF bases — Tindal, Darwin and possibly Amberley — being prepared primarily for US strategic bomber use with associated aerial tankers.

The legal basis is the Compact of Free Association: Palau, the FSM and the Marshall Islands became independent nations that signed compacts with the United States, under which Washington retained responsibility for their defense and gained exclusive access to their land and waterways for strategic purposes. In the years ahead, Yap's airport may see deployments of US tankers and F-35 fighter jets. China's primary counter to ACE is the continued expansion of the People's Liberation Army Rocket Force, with large inventories of ballistic, cruise and hypersonic missiles intended to hold US airfields at risk across the First and Second Island Chains.
en.summary: The US Air Force is expanding airfields across the Second Island Chain under its Agile Combat Employment doctrine, with about $400 million requested for a runway extension at Yap International Airport to disperse aircraft from Andersen Air Force Base in Guam.
en.title: Why The US Military Is Expanding A Remote Pacific Airport To Reduce Its Reliance On Guam

body: 美國正擴建第二島鏈多座機場與飛行場，作為空軍「敏捷作戰部署」（ACE）概念的一環，以分散關島的軍機、降低對安德森空軍基地的依賴。其中，密克羅尼西亞聯邦雅浦島的雅浦國際機場即將展開重大改造；空軍2025財政年度軍事建設預算申請中，跑道延長及相關工程編列約4億美元，首期款項為9600萬美元，計畫執行已自2025財政年度順延至2026財政年度，作者造訪時工程尚未動工。
雅浦國際機場目前是僅有一條跑道的簡易機場，定期客運航班只有每週2班自關島飛來的聯合航空波音737 MAX 8，以及太平洋宣教航空每週1班自帛琉飛來的超級空中國王客機。機場旁即為日軍二戰機場遺址，散落約8架遭美軍轟炸摧毀的日機殘骸。作者10月至11月造訪雅浦時，島上美軍足跡極少，工程尚未開始。
擴建的戰略背景是中國崛起使關島成為首要打擊目標。美國在二戰後將空中力量集中於關島，並在日本與韓國維持前進基地；如今若無關島或有效替代方案，美國在該區域投射空中力量的能力將大幅削弱。雅浦機場的經費說明強調，需要更長跑道與設施以支援大型軍機執行訓練、作戰、應變與敏捷作戰部署任務；在高強度衝突中，雅浦很可能名列中國的戰略打擊目標。
類似工程遍及整個第二島鏈：帛琉貝里琉機場正在大規模擴建，安加爾機場已完工；關島方面，美國空軍正擴建安德森空軍基地停機坪並修復鄰近已廢棄的西北機場；天寧島國際機場與北機場也在擴建與修復中，人口不足2000人的羅塔島亦受關注。澳洲北部廷達爾、達爾文與可能納入的安伯利等皇家澳洲空軍基地，則正為美國戰略轟炸機與空中加油機的使用做準備。
美國與這些島嶼的關係源於《自由聯合協定》：帛琉、密克羅尼西亞聯邦與馬紹爾群島獨立後與美國簽署協定，美國負責其防務，換取對其土地與水域的戰略專屬使用權。在可預見的未來，雅浦機場可能迎來美國加油機與F-35戰機的部署；中國人民解放軍火箭軍持續擴充的彈道飛彈、巡弋飛彈與高超音速飛彈，正是針對第一與第二島鏈美軍機場的威脅。
zh.summary: 美國空軍正依「敏捷作戰部署」概念擴建第二島鏈機場，其中雅浦國際機場跑道延長工程已編列約4億美元，首期9600萬美元，以分散關島安德森空軍基地的戰時風險。
zh.title: 美軍為何擴建偏遠太平洋機場、降低對關島依賴
